7b38ab9c83.why: The bit-scan result, both 16-byte stores, and both pointer updates are required, and SSE2 cannot combine the stores into one instruction.

00e57a3d73.why: The loaded value and sum must both survive, and replacing the copy and ADD with LEA would lose the required carry flag.

d3001b9aff.why: The store, load, and both pointer updates are required, while the live loaded value and carry flag prevent folding the copy and ADD into LEA.

db8892dfb1.why: The comparison already folds its load, and the vector result, extracted mask, updated counter, and scalar comparison flags are all required.

a236f97740.why: The store, loaded ymm3, comparison vector, extracted mask, and both counter updates are all live, so folding the load would still require reproducing ymm3.

6d4e27ed8b.why: The old ymm2 must be stored and its replacement preserved, while the comparison vector, extracted mask, and both counter updates are also required.

41c8f12065.why: The loaded ymm3 and comparison vector must both survive, and the store, mask extraction, and two counter updates each remain necessary.

8f6b32e24a.why: Both loaded vectors, the comparison vector, the extracted mask, and the scalar comparison flags must survive, preventing any load or operation from being removed.

ba2f82e70b.why: The store, byte-comparison vector, extracted mask, and scalar comparison flags are distinct required effects already produced in four instructions.

58055c55e4.why: The zero-byte store, original destination in rax, incremented rdi, and decremented r8 with matching subtraction flags each require their existing operation.

0180b5ffbb.why: All three additions and the bit scan produce required register values, and the final comparison must independently establish the required carry flag.

9815748107.why: The add/subtract pair cannot become a single LEA because addressing cannot subtract an arbitrary register, and the pointer update, bit scan, and carry-producing comparison remain necessary.

4aa51751bc.why: The zero-extended load, word store, two distinct destination-derived register values, and counter subtraction with matching flags are all required.

ae01414ebd.why: The live zero-extended load, separate word and zero-byte stores, two destination-derived register values, and flag-producing counter subtraction cannot be reduced.

076edb94d0.why: The live dword load, dword store, two distinct destination-derived register values, and counter subtraction with matching flags each require an instruction.

909a95c119.why: Both indexed copies and destination-derived register values are required, and combining the two subtractions would not generally preserve the final decrement's carry and overflow flags.

c9b0ca7079.why: Both loaded registers, both stores, and both destination-derived register values are live, while the final subtraction's flags prevent merging the counter arithmetic.

494ae52b0a.why: Both vector loads and stores are required at their unknown indexed addresses, including zeroed upper halves of ymm2 and ymm3, and merging the counter subtractions would change required flags.

8b485510df.why: Both full-width vector results and stores are required at their unknown indexed addresses, and the destination calculations and flag-sensitive counter subtractions have no removable operation.

2eec1d8180.why: The zero-extended byte load, byte store, return-address calculation, and VZEROUPPER are all observable because full ymm register values must match.
